name: Pain And Hurt
overview: Scripture reveals that in times of pain and hurt, the LORD faithfully shepherds His people, providing for their needs and drawing near to the brokenhearted with saving grace. He offers refuge and healing to those who dwell in His presence, binding up wounds and bringing rest to those who are burdened. God's plans for His people are rooted in peace and hope, assuring believers that their suffering is met with divine comfort and a promised future.
